_comment: The credential vault: every secret the hub keeps, one AES-256-GCM ciphertext each under a random data key. `nhub setup` writes wrapped_key — the data key sealed under the master passphrase — and the working key lives as state in /var/lib/neutrino/vault.key. Managed from the Credentials page and by `nhub vault`; never edited by hand.
_comment_fields: Each entry under secrets is keyed by a panel-assigned uuid4 hex id. name, kind, meta and created_at stay readable; nonce and data are base64, data sealing the kind's secret fields as JSON. kind is token | login | ssh_key. Underscore-prefixed keys, this placeholder entry included, are documentation and are ignored.
